## Change

Describe the problem, trigger, and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Verification

Record focused checks and their results. Distinguish synthetic tests, real SDK contract checks, and tenant ingestion; do not imply one establishes the others.

## Deployment impact

Describe configuration, checkpoint, mapping, or dependency changes and any migration needed.

- [ ] Examples and fixtures use synthetic values only.
- [ ] No secrets, tenant identifiers, live payloads, proprietary SDK files, or vendor-only documents are included.
- [ ] Relevant mapping and operator documentation is updated.
- [ ] Checkpoint and redaction behavior are preserved or explicitly covered by verification.
